I've added the **LinkedIn-connector idea** to `notes/linkedin-connector.md` (and indexed it in `notes/README.md`). The research shifted the recommendation, so here's the short version:

- **No official API** for arbitrary profile data — partner-gated (~5% acceptance, ~6-mo wait); only Company-Page analytics are openly allowed.
- **Scraping / 3rd-party APIs (Proxycurl, LinkupAPI, browser MCPs) violate LinkedIn's ToS.** *hiQ v. LinkedIn* means scraping public data isn't a *crime*, but it's a ToS breach → account ban / civil suit. LinkedIn **sued Proxycurl's parent (Nubela) in Jan 2025**; Apollo & Seamless got pulled. Risky and fragile.
- **No official Claude/Claude Code LinkedIn tool** — community MCP servers exist but inherit that scraping risk; this environment only has Gmail/Calendar/Drive/Mermaid.
- **Safe, high-leverage version:** ingest your **own** LinkedIn data export (`Connections.csv`) and cross-reference it against `target-companies.md` to auto-build the "20 people who can intro me" referral list (referrals beat cold-apply ~5:1). That's the version worth building.

Sources: [SociaVault: Is the LinkedIn API free 2026](https://sociavault.com/blog/linkedin-api-free-2026), [SociaVault: scraping legal guide 2026](https://sociavault.com/blog/linkedin-scraping-legal-guide-2026), [hiQ v. LinkedIn (Wikipedia)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HiQ_Labs_v._LinkedIn), [linkedin-mcp-server (GitHub)](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server).
